{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Democrats believe a strong, secure, and democratic Israel is vital to the interests of the United States.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats' commitment to Israel's security, its qualitative military edge, its right to defend itself, and the 2016 Memorandum of Understanding is ironclad.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats recognize the worth of every Israeli and every Palestinian.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will work to help bring to an end a conflict that has brought so much pain to so many.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats support a negotiated two-state solution that ensures Israel's future as a Jewish and democratic state with recognized borders.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats support a negotiated two-state solution that upholds the right of Palestinians to live in freedom and security in a viable state of their own.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats oppose any unilateral steps by either side—including annexation—that undermine prospects for two states.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will continue to stand against incitement and terror.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Democrats oppose settlement expansion.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Democrats believe Jerusalem should remain the capital of Israel, an undivided city accessible to people of all faiths, while it is a matter for final status negotiations.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will restore U.S.-Palestinian diplomatic ties.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will restore critical assistance to the Palestinian people in the West Bank and Gaza, consistent with U.S. law.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Democrats oppose any effort to unfairly single out and delegitimize Israel, including at the United Nations or through the Boycott, Divestment, and Sanctions Movement.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will protect the Constitutional right of citizens to free speech.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
